title: Event-Driven Microservices
description: Runnable demos of the three core event-driven patterns: an event-sourced order aggregate, the transactional outbox with a relay, and saga orchestration with compensation.
description_es: Demos ejecutables de los tres patrones event-driven centrales: un agregado de pedido event-sourced, el outbox transaccional con relay y la orquestación de sagas con compensación.
